effect.name: GM Zoom Trail Composer
effect.desc: Layered zoom echoes with geometric decay, color drift and center-aware trail compositing.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,q=uv-center;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec3 sum=vec3(0),screen=vec3(1);float ws=0.0,w=1.0,count=clamp(floor(echoes+.5),2.0,24.0);for(int i=0;i<24;i++){if(float(i)>=count)break;float t=float(i)/max(count-1.0,1.0);vec4 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(center+q*(1.0+distance*t),0.0,1.0));vec3 tint=.75+.25*cos(vec3(0,2.1,4.2)+t*colorDrift*6.0);sum+=c.rgb*tint*w;screen*=1.0-clamp(c.rgb*tint*w,0.0,1.0);ws+=w;w*=decay;}vec3 outRgb=sum/max(ws,.001);if(blendMode==1)outRgb=1.0-screen;if(blendMode==2)outRgb=sum;gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,outRgb,mixAmount),src.a);}
